content.title: Changing the time range clears a locked allocation selection

check.operand: each legend entry includes an asset class label

content.test_md_blob:
# Changing the time range clears a locked allocation selection

> Prove a supported time-range change clears an existing locked allocation selection so the card does not keep stale focus after context changes.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} and wait for the ORBITAL Portfolio Overview dashboard to load with the Allocation Card visible.

## Step 2

On the Allocation Card, click the Equities segment so the card enters its focused selection state for that allocation.

## Step 3

In the workspace header time-range segmented control, change the active range from 1M to 3M.

## Step 4

On the Allocation Card, confirm the prior allocation selection is cleared after the time-range change and confirm the legend still shows each allocation entry with an asset class, percentage, and value.

## Step 5 — assert @verifies ac-56, ac-48, ac-49, ac-50

Confirm presence check: each legend entry includes an asset class label (forall) — the stated promise: Each legend entry shows an asset class.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: Open {{start_url}} and wait for the ORBITAL Portfolio Overview dashboard to load with the Allocation Card visible.
    step: 1
  - objective: On the Allocation Card, click the Equities segment so the card enters its focused selection state for that allocation.
    step: 2
  - objective: In the workspace header time-range segmented control, change the active range from 1M to 3M.
    step: 3
  - objective: On the Allocation Card, confirm the prior allocation selection is cleared after the time-range change and confirm the legend still shows each allocation entry with an asset class, percentage, and value.
    step: 4
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: presence
      operand: each legend entry includes an asset class label
      operator: forall
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-48
    objective: 'Confirm presence check: each legend entry includes an asset class label (forall) — the stated promise: Each legend entry shows an asset class.'
    step: 5
scenario: Changing the time range clears a locked allocation selection
title: Changing the time range clears a locked allocation selection

content.test_md_blob:
# Lock and unlock an allocation segment by clicking it

> Prove clicking a segment maintains a focused allocation state and clicking the same segment again clears that lock.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} and wait for the ORBITAL Portfolio Overview dashboard to load with the Allocation Card visible.

## Step 2

On the Allocation Card, click the Equities segment once and confirm the card enters its focused state for that allocation.

## Step 3

On the Allocation Card, click the same Equities segment again and confirm the focused state clears.

## Step 4

Confirm the Allocation Card legend continues to show each allocation entry with an asset class, percentage, and value after the click-lock and click-unlock cycle.

## Step 5 — assert @verifies ac-54, ac-55, ac-48, ac-49, ac-50

Confirm presence check: each legend entry includes a percentage (forall) — the stated promise: Each legend entry shows a percentage.

  - objective: On the Allocation Card, click the same Equities segment again and confirm the focused state clears.

  - objective: Confirm the Allocation Card legend continues to show each allocation entry with an asset class, percentage, and value after the click-lock and click-unlock cycle.

check.operand: the legend item matching the hovered segment is highlighted

content.test_md_blob:
# Hover an allocation segment to focus the matching legend item

> Prove hovering any allocation segment provides transient focus feedback by expanding the segment and highlighting the matching legend item.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} and wait for the ORBITAL Portfolio Overview dashboard to load with the Allocation Card visible.

## Step 2

Store the rendered size of the Equities segment in the Allocation Card as baseline_equities_segment_size.

## Step 3

Hover the Equities segment in the Allocation Card and confirm the segment grows by 4px from baseline_equities_segment_size and the matching Equities legend entry is highlighted.

## Step 4

Repeat the hover confirmation for Fixed Income, Alternatives, Cash, and Commodities, one segment at a time, confirming that each hovered segment highlights its own matching legend entry before moving to the next segment.

## Step 5 — assert @verifies ac-51, ac-52

Confirm presence check: the legend item matching the hovered segment is highlighted (forall) — the stated promise: Hovering a segment highlights the matching legend item.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: Open {{start_url}} and wait for the ORBITAL Portfolio Overview dashboard to load with the Allocation Card visible.
    step: 1
  - objective: Store the rendered size of the Equities segment in the Allocation Card as baseline_equities_segment_size.
    step: 2
  - objective: Hover the Equities segment in the Allocation Card and confirm the segment grows by 4px from baseline_equities_segment_size and the matching Equities legend entry is highlighted.
    step: 3
  - objective: Repeat the hover confirmation for Fixed Income, Alternatives, Cash, and Commodities, one segment at a time, confirming that each hovered segment highlights its own matching legend entry before moving to the next segment.
    step: 4
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: presence
      operand: the legend item matching the hovered segment is highlighted
      operator: forall
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-52
    objective: 'Confirm presence check: the legend item matching the hovered segment is highlighted (forall) — the stated promise: Hovering a segment highlights the matching legend item.'
    step: 5
scenario: Hover an allocation segment to focus the matching legend item
title: Hover an allocation segment to focus the matching legend item

content.title: Review the default portfolio allocation breakdown
content.test_md_blob:
# Review the default portfolio allocation breakdown

> Prove the allocation card renders the default donut data, center total, and legend fields needed to compare asset classes before any interaction.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} and wait for the ORBITAL Portfolio Overview dashboard to load with the Allocation Card visible.

## Step 2

On the Allocation Card, confirm the donut chart legend lists Equities 48%, Fixed Income 24%, Alternatives 13%, Cash 9%, and Commodities 6%.

## Step 3

In the center of the Allocation Card, confirm the amount is $24.8M and the label is TOTAL.

## Step 4

Confirm each Allocation Card legend entry shows the asset class name, percentage, and value.

## Step 5 — assert @verifies ac-41, ac-42, ac-43, ac-44, ac-45, ac-46, ac-47, ac-48, ac-49, ac-50

Confirm absolute check: $24.8M (equals) — the stated promise: The chart center amount is "$24.8M" by default.
content.objectives_blob:
objectives:
  - objective: Open {{start_url}} and wait for the ORBITAL Portfolio Overview dashboard to load with the Allocation Card visible.
    step: 1
  - objective: On the Allocation Card, confirm the donut chart legend lists Equities 48%, Fixed Income 24%, Alternatives 13%, Cash 9%, and Commodities 6%.
    step: 2
  - objective: In the center of the Allocation Card, confirm the amount is $24.8M and the label is TOTAL.
    step: 3
  - objective: Confirm each Allocation Card legend entry shows the asset class name, percentage, and value.
    step: 4
  - check:
      expected_mode: authored
      kind: absolute
      operand: $24.8M
      operator: equals
      review_required: false
      verified_against: ac-46
    objective: 'Confirm absolute check: $24.8M (equals) — the stated promise: The chart center amount is "$24.8M" by default.'
    step: 5
scenario: Review the default portfolio allocation breakdown
title: Review the default portfolio allocation breakdown

judgements.rationale: [value_score] Kept first because stale analytical focus after a time-range change would mislead the investment professional at a context boundary.
[value_score] Kept second because locking and unlocking focus is the main sustained-comparison behavior for the allocation chart.
[value_score] Kept third because hover highlighting is the primary discoverable interaction that links the donut segment to the legend.
[value_score] Kept fourth because correct default data is foundational but less interaction-sensitive than the focus and reset paths.

[self_critique] Oracle discipline: I did not assert that clearing selection restores "$24.8M TOTAL" because the observable cleared state is still unspecified in gap-backed criteria; the written check stays on sourced legend presence only.

[self_critique] Technique fit and over-breadth: I authored the actual click-lock and click-unlock journey, but I avoided inventing a locked-state visual oracle or a default-state restoration claim that the source does not define.

[self_critique] Technique fit: Hover coverage stayed on the defined visual behaviors — 4px expansion and matching legend highlight — and did not assert the selected-allocation center content because gap-3 leaves that content unresolved.

[self_critique] Negative-case sweep: I did not add an empty, invalid, or error-state assertion because the source describes a fixed populated dashboard card with no user input or alternate result family to negate.
